name: Complex Domain Coloring
desc: A living phase portrait of a complex rational function whose drifting poles and zeros bloom into glowing rosettes, the argument painting a full phase-wheel of hue while the modulus carves concentric contour rings and radial rays across the plane.

scale.doc: complex-plane zoom (higher = bigger rosettes, features fill the frame)

density.doc: contour ring + phase-ray frequency (higher = many nested level curves)

warp.doc: pole/zero orbit radius — how far the singularities swing, churning the field

hue.doc: palette base-hue offset added to the phase wheel
